events.title: Portrait From a Seventies Film
must_haves: The woman remains recognisable as the woman in the source portrait.
Her curly dark hair, sweater and head-and-shoulders framing are retained.
The park background remains identifiable rather than becoming a different setting.
Warm, faded colour grading and visible film grain give the image a 1970s film-still appearance.
The output is square and contains no added text.

answer_sheet.Style and mood: A nostalgic 1970s colour film still, with warm faded colours and visible film grain.
answer_sheet.What to preserve: Her identity, curly dark hair, sweater, pose and park setting.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One square image; free-tier resolution is fine.

No text, please.
